Reference / mail/mbox

mail/mbox#

mbox archives in the mboxrd flavour: messages one after another, each behind a From line.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let record = MboxRecord(separator: MboxSeparator("From ada@example.test Thu Nov 13 10:00:00 2026"), message: message);
let bytes = MboxArchive(record).bytes();
let back = ParsedMbox(bytes).records();
back.first().message();

Description#

mbox archives in the mboxrd flavour: messages one after another, each behind a From line.

Lines of the archive end in LF, messages inside keep CRLF, and a From line inside a message is quoted with > and unquoted when read. By default an archive holds 1000 messages and 64 MiB. Mbox in mail/mbox_store keeps one in a file.
